notes.title: 7 DAYS RELEASE DATE
notes.notes: [p]Hello 7-dayers![/p][p][/p][p]I've got a couple of things to share...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]GOOD ROUTE: DONE[/h1][p]The good route of 7 Days is done! Day 1-7 are finished and playtesting has begun! That means work on the other main routes will start soon!!![/p][p][/p][h1]7 DAYS RELEASE DATE[/h1][p]7 Days will release on August 30, 2025! Maybe?[/p][p]That was the plan, but apperently Steam doesn't really let you release on weekends. Damn.[/p][p]The release on the Steam page has been set to August 29 (for now), but it'll be around that time.[/p][p][/p][h1]FINAL TRAILER[/h1][p]The final trailer for 7 Days is out! It includes new content from the full game, a banger song (remix of 7 Days by Daver The Dave, feat. Senchu & Jenna), and the release date![/p][p]Check it out![/p][previewyoutube="VUnLvhl-ERk;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]STEAM NEXT FEST[/h1][p]7 Days will be joining June's Steam Next Fest! Hopefully this might bring some new eyes to the game :)[/p][p]Be sure to let everyone you know about 7 Days, force them to wishlist and download the demo. MAKE THEM PART OF THE 7 DAYS GANG. RAHHHHHHHH[/p][p][/p][h1]7 DAYS LIVE SOUNDTRACK CONCERT[/h1][p]I'm a music student, and this entire year I had to work on a project to prove I'm worthy of graduating (or something idk). I chose to incorporate my game into this project! I wrote a 50 page essay about evoking emotions in video game music, and recently we played a couple songs from 7 Days live on stage, with background visuals of the game![/p][p]Check it out!!!!![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eQPyMJ5p2EY;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now! Thanks for being so awesome.[/p][p][/p][p]Daver The Dave [/p]
